fresh_process_samples: No OS cache flushing; first samples are fresh-process, not OS-cold.
ipc_interpretation: Foreground IPC coverage is the union of recorded invocation/body-read intervals inside the browser timer. Elapsed minus this union includes UI handling, rendering, frames and waits; it is not a direct paint profile. Background note polling remains in elapsed and is reported separately.

pilot.interpretation: Pilot continuation gate only; final source acceptance still needs the charter gates and matrix.
